About Me

Welcome! I’m a passionate developer with a strong focus on real-time graphics and game engine architecture. I love diving deep into low-level APIs like DirectX 12 and building complex systems from the ground up.

My journey in software development has been driven by a curiosity for how things work, from the rendering pipeline of a modern game to the intricacies of academic research.

This website showcases some of the projects I’m most proud of. Feel free to explore and get in touch!
